name: crystal_extension_comms
description: Send messages or inspect inboxes/outboxes/audit logs via the embedded Crystal Comms extension.

action.description: Action: send message or list messages (inbox, outbox, or audit log)

crystal_id.description: Target crystal ID providing the comms boundary

from.description: Sender entity ID (required for send; optional outbox filter for list)

to.description: List of recipient IDs (or single '@all', '@channel', 'grp_*') for send

inbox.description: Recipient entity ID to inspect inbox (for list)

outbox.description: Sender entity ID to inspect outbox (for list)

json_output.description: Return JSON array of CommsMessage objects (default: false)
